voice.name: JP - Social media
voice.why: A clear middle-aged French voice for Lucien Roux, the bank clerk off the counter (renamed from Helene on 2026-11-22; male body, male voice).

greet_refuses.text: I count other people's money all day. I will not waste my words on you.

greet_wary.text: Mm. I remember you. Mind your manners and we will get along.

greet.text: Good day. I am off the counter just now, but I don't bite. Lucien, from the bank.

greet_friendly.text: Ah, hello again. Your account is in better shape than most, you know.

greet_regular.text: There you are! Sit down a minute. The bank can wait.

about_work.text: I keep the counter at the First Bank of Everon. Deposits, withdrawals, and listening to the farmers argue about the price of feed.

about_advice.text: Bank your pay the day you get it. What sits in your pocket can walk off. What sits with us stays yours.

about_town.text: Saint-Philippe gossips faster than the telephone. If you want to know a thing, sit at the cafe and wait.

replies.work: What do you do at the bank?
